drafts.angle: 100X agents still need a brand gate (rides @levie context thesis)
drafts.draft_en:
We're heading toward 100X more agents touching your brand than people do.

Every one of them will try to pull context, generate creative, and ship.

The bottleneck isn't model IQ. It's whether the agent can see the rules that actually matter: brand, legal, and platform policy.

Aubric turns those rules into a gate that returns approve, fix, or block before anything goes live.

Give your agents the critical context. Then make them prove the creative clears it.
drafts.video_tip: 18s vertical: swarm of agent avatars generating ads in parallel, each stamped with a red X until one passes through an Aubric gate labeled APPROVE. End on '100X agents. One brand gate.' Keep the @levie density: short captions, one idea per beat.

drafts.angle: AI will rewrite ads too, with a scoreboard (rides @rauchg rewrite + Security Review)
drafts.draft_en:
We will all learn this about AI-made ads too:

• Most of them ship off-brand
• Most of them invent a claim legal never cleared
• Most of them would fail a platform review on day one

AI will rewrite creative volume. Brands still need a 24h audit loop that finds the issues and forces approve, fix, or block before spend.

Run the next AI ad through Aubric the way Vercel is running Security Reviews on code.
drafts.video_tip: 20s screen capture: paste an AI ad, watch a live counter of issues found, freeze on APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK. Borrow @rauchg's checkmark scoreboard rhythm. Use sanitized real numbers only.

drafts.angle: How to not ship AI slop in ads (rides @gregisenberg checklist + Omni video meta)
drafts.draft_en:
How to not ship AI slop in ads:

1. Write brand rules as executable checks, not a PDF nobody opens
2. Ban vague claim words unless legal cleared them
3. Gate every frame and voiceover the same way you gate the copy
4. Require approve, fix, or block before anyone hits publish

Gemini Omni just made 15-second ad video cheaper and easier. Volume is not the hard part anymore. Clearance is.

Aubric is the clearance gate. Steal the checklist, then put a real verifier behind it.
drafts.video_tip: 25s vertical list: each rule appears as a sticky note, gets stamped CHECKED, final frame shows Aubric verdict. Close with a 15s Omni-style product shot that flips from BLOCK to APPROVE. Bookmark bait: keep under 5 lines on screen.
